name: meter-bar
title: MeterBar
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A limit meter, or a stacked composition bar weighted by amount. Use to show a share or a spend against a ceiling.

hairline.purpose: Shows a proportion or a limit.
dontUseWhen: a precise comparison of many values
hairline.antiExampleWhy: Native progress carries browser styling the system does not control.

docs: Pass `over` when spend exceeds the limit; the component will not infer it, because the threshold is a policy decision.
